mapper.select: select A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, A.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, A.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodTypeCode, A.PRIN as prin, A.CCY as ccy, DATE_FORMAT(A.VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as vdate1, DATE_FORMAT(A.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as mdate1, A.TERM as term, A.TERM_TYPE as termType, A.INT_TYPE as intType, A.INT_RATE*100 as intRate, A.INT_RATE_ID as intRateId, A.BASIS as basis, A.M_PRIN_AMT as mPrinAmt, A.M_INT_AMT as mIntAmt, A.M_TRADE_AMT as mTradeAmt, A.TRADE_MARKET AS tradeMarket, A.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE as capiIncomeFeature, A.CALENDAR_ID as calendarId, B.CALENDAR_NAME as calendarName, a.contract_no contractNo, DATE_FORMAT(a.vpay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') vpayDate , DATE_FORMAT(a.mpay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') mpayDate , a.act_cap_days actCapDays, c.se_rep_day_type seRepDayType, c.se_rep_day_type seRepDayTypeCode FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN MST_CALENDAR_INFO B ON B.CALENDAR_ID = A.CALENDAR_ID left join fin_product_valuation_para c on a.finprod_id=c.finprod_id and a.branch=c.branch WHERE (A.BRANCH = 0 OR A.BRANCH is null) AND A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
